purpose: Verify workflow path from Draft quiz creation, question attachment, to immediate publication
preconditions: Professor user authorized for CS101
action_or_input: QuizService.create_quiz(title='Pop Quiz', start_time=now-1m, end_time=now+1d) then QuizService.publish_quiz(quiz.id)
expected_result: Quiz transitions from DRAFT to PUBLISHED and is immediately available

purpose: Verify workflow prevents invalid transition from DRAFT directly to CLOSED
preconditions: Quiz in DRAFT status
action_or_input: transition_quiz(quiz, 'CLOSED')
expected_result: ConflictError raised: Cannot transition quiz from DRAFT to CLOSED

purpose: Verify workflow path for future scheduled quiz: Draft to Published/Scheduled state
preconditions: start_time is in future (now + 2 hours), end_time is now + 5 hours
action_or_input: Create quiz with future schedule and invoke QuizService.publish_quiz(quiz.id)
expected_result: Quiz status set to PUBLISHED with future availability window intact

purpose: Verify workflow blocks attempt start transition when quiz is scheduled but start boundary not reached
preconditions: Published quiz with start_time in future
action_or_input: QuizService.start_attempt(quiz.id, 'student_1')
expected_result: ValueError raised: Quiz is not currently available for attempt

purpose: Verify workflow path for closing an active quiz upon reaching closing boundary
preconditions: Quiz in PUBLISHED status
action_or_input: transition_quiz(quiz, 'CLOSED'); quiz.save()
expected_result: Quiz status transitions from PUBLISHED to CLOSED

purpose: Verify workflow path for archiving a closed quiz
preconditions: Quiz in CLOSED status
action_or_input: Invoke archive action on closed quiz
expected_result: Quiz transitions to ARCHIVED state and is archived from active views

purpose: Verify complete student attempt workflow: start -> save answers -> manual submit -> evaluated
preconditions: Published active quiz with 1 MCQ question
action_or_input: start_attempt -> save_answer -> submit_attempt(autosubmit=False)
expected_result: Attempt status progresses from IN_PROGRESS to SUBMITTED to EVALUATED with score calculated

purpose: Verify student can abort submission confirmation dialog and continue attempt
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS with answers saved
action_or_input: Student prompts submission check then cancels before confirmation
expected_result: Attempt remains in IN_PROGRESS state without status transition

purpose: Verify workflow auto-submits active attempt upon duration expiry
preconditions: Attempt in IN_PROGRESS, current time exceeds started_at + duration_minutes
action_or_input: QuizService.save_answer(attempt.id, question.id, {'choice': 'A'})
expected_result: ValueError raised: Time expired, and attempt transitions to EVALUATED with submitted_at set

purpose: Verify workflow locks attempt against subsequent answer saves after expiry submission
preconditions: Attempt has been auto-submitted due to expiry
action_or_input: Attempt to save answer on the auto-submitted attempt
expected_result: ValueError raised: Attempt is closed

purpose: Verify objective attempt evaluation followed by professor grade release
preconditions: Attempt submitted with objective question answers
action_or_input: QuizService.submit_attempt(attempt.id) then QuizService.toggle_release(quiz.id, 'grades_released', True)
expected_result: Attempt is EVALUATED with autograded score and quiz grades_released=True

purpose: Verify evaluated results remain hidden from student until professor executes release
preconditions: Attempt evaluated, but quiz.grades_released is False
action_or_input: Student requests GET /quizzing/api/attempts/{id}/
expected_result: HTTP 403 Forbidden: Grades are withheld until explicitly released

purpose: Verify subjective evaluation workflow: professor manual grading and score override
preconditions: Submitted attempt with subjective answer
action_or_input: QuizService.override_score(answer.id, override_score=Decimal('4.0'), feedback='Good')
expected_result: Answer override_score=4.0 and attempt total_score updated

purpose: Verify attempt with subjective questions transitions to UNDER_REVIEW state upon submission
preconditions: Attempt on quiz containing subjective questions submitted
action_or_input: Submit attempt with unevaluated subjective questions
expected_result: Attempt status is set to 'UNDER_REVIEW' pending professor subjective grading

purpose: Verify AI-assisted evaluation workflow provides suggestions for professor confirmation
preconditions: Subjective submission awaiting grading
action_or_input: Invoke AI subjective grading service for attempt answer
expected_result: AI returns suggested score and reasoning without finalizing score until approved

purpose: Verify mixed quiz workflow: objective portion autograded and manual score combined into total
preconditions: Attempt with MCQ (marks=2) and subjective (marks=5) questions
action_or_input: Submit attempt (MCQ autograded to 2) then override subjective answer with 4.5
expected_result: Final total_score accurately aggregates autograded and override scores (6.5)

purpose: Verify workflow prevents grade release while subjective items in mixed quiz are un-evaluated
preconditions: Mixed quiz with pending subjective answers
action_or_input: Attempt to toggle grades_released=True before subjective grading completes
expected_result: ConflictError: Cannot release grades while subjective questions remain ungraded

purpose: Verify student accesses final evaluated score and feedback after professor release
preconditions: Quiz with grades_released=True and evaluated attempt
action_or_input: get_attempt_by_id(attempt.id)
expected_result: Returns attempt with total_score and answer details

purpose: Verify student can view answer key when answer_key_released=True
preconditions: Quiz with answer_key_released=True
action_or_input: QuizService.toggle_release(quiz.id, 'answer_key_released', True)
expected_result: quiz.answer_key_released is True and answer key is visible to students

purpose: Verify end-to-end composite workflow: Draft -> Add Questions -> Publish -> Close
preconditions: Authorized professor
action_or_input: Execute complete quiz lifecycle sequence from creation to closure
expected_result: Quiz passes through DRAFT, PUBLISHED, and CLOSED states successfully

purpose: Verify workflow prohibits reopening a CLOSED quiz back to PUBLISHED state
preconditions: Quiz in CLOSED status
action_or_input: transition_quiz(quiz, 'PUBLISHED')
expected_result: ConflictError raised: Cannot transition quiz from CLOSED to PUBLISHED

purpose: Verify end-to-end composite attempt lifecycle: Start -> Save -> Submit -> Lock
preconditions: Published quiz with 2 questions
action_or_input: Student starts attempt, saves answers for both questions, submits attempt
expected_result: Attempt fully evaluated, total_score calculated, and subsequent modifications rejected

purpose: Verify workflow prevents student from starting a second attempt when permitted limit is 1
preconditions: Quiz with permitted_attempts=1; student has completed 1 attempt
action_or_input: Student attempts to start attempt 2 on same quiz
expected_result: ValueError raised: Attempt limit reached for this quiz

purpose: Verify composite evaluation lifecycle: Submission -> Autograding -> Score Override -> Grade Release
preconditions: Active attempt with answers
action_or_input: Submit attempt -> verify autograded score -> override score -> toggle grades_released
expected_result: Complete evaluation pipeline succeeds and grades are released

purpose: Verify composite workflow calculates pass/fail status against passing marks threshold
preconditions: Quiz with total_marks=10.0, passing_marks=5.0; student scored 4.0
action_or_input: Complete evaluation workflow and verify pass/fail outcome
expected_result: Evaluated attempt record reflects fail status (is_passed=False)

purpose: Verify submitting an already evaluated attempt is idempotent and does not corrupt scores
preconditions: Attempt already in EVALUATED status with total_score=2.0
action_or_input: QuizService.submit_attempt(attempt.id)
expected_result: Returns existing evaluated attempt; total_score remains 2.0 without re-evaluation corruption
